title: Say Goodbye to Wandering Trader│道別流浪商人
description: Now, when you hope for the next Wandering Trader, you don't have to kill the current Wandering Trader in a brutal way.│現在，當你期待著下一個流浪商人出現時，你不必以殘忍的方式殺死當前的流浪商人。
body:
# Introduce│介紹
Sneaking + Right-clicking Wandering Trader will open the UI. You can click the "Sure" button to say goodbye to the wandering trader, who will disappear on his own after a few seconds.│潛行 + 右鍵點擊流浪商人會開啟UI，可以點擊其中的"確定"按鈕來與流浪商人告別，流浪商人將會在幾秒後自行消失。
